newsitem.title: USA: Colt Telecom expected IPO price rises.
newsitem.headline: Colt Telecom expected IPO price rises.

text.p: Colt Telecom Group Plc's initial public offering of 26.7 million ordinary shares is expected to price at about $18.08 per American Depositary Share (ADS), underwriter Morgan Stanley said on Monday.
Each ADS represents four ordinary shares.
Earlier, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the offering was expected to price at between $14.83 and $16.80 per ADS.
Of the 26.7 million ordinary shares, 13.35 million shares are being offered in the United States and Canada, while 13.35 million shares are being offered in other countries, according the SEC filing.
The London-based company provides local telecommunications services in London and Frankfurt, Germany.
The IPO is expected to price late on Monday for trading on Tuesday, according to the underwriter.
